From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Alyssa Chen <alyssa@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: FY28 scenario playbook: target envelopes, cadence and QBR storyline

Team —

We need to lock the high-level playbook for FY28 planning and the QBR narrative by the end of next week so the execs have a clean story for the board packet. I put together an initial template (attached) with three scenarios: Base, Optimistic, and Constrained. Key asks here:

- Review the scenario envelopes in column B-D and call out any optimistic levers you think are realistic (pricing, NDAs, channel motions).
- Marcus: please confirm the hiring ramp assumptions in the capacity sheet (sheet 2).
- Jonas/Vivek: I need the cadence for sign-off — who signs the target bands and on what dates (we should aim for a one-week approval window).
- Soojin: can you draft a short QBR storyline overlay (1 pager) that ties the scenarios to GTM motions? I added a starter doc.

Attached: FY28_scenario_templates.xlsx, QBR_storyline_draft.md (starter bullets)

Proposed timeline:
- Thu 6/11 EOD: internal comments in the sheet
- Fri 6/12 10:00 AM PT: 30-minute review to align (calendar invite to follow)
- Wed 6/17: leadership sign-off window opens

If we diverge materially (>=10% headcount or >$1.5M spend delta) we'll flag for an exec readout.

Thanks — let’s keep this tight.

Irene Choi
VP, Strategy & Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: FY28_scenario_templates.xlsx (Excel, 85KB)]
[Attachment: QBR_storyline_draft.md (Markdown, 6KB)]
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: FY28 scenario playbook: target envelopes, cadence and QBR storyline

Irene — thanks for pulling this together. Quick reactions:

- The base-case revenue cadence looks reasonable but the optimistic scenario assumes a faster enterprise win rate — we should gate that on two GTM hires and one marketplace placement. I added a comment in the sheet with the hire timing.
- On sign-off: recommend the following approvers and order: (1) GTM (Jonas) -> (2) Finance -> (3) Exec committee (me + Irene) — allow 5 business days for steps 1–2 and 2 business days for Exec. This keeps us within the one-week target.
- Risks: customer-driven discounts and slower marketplace certification. I flagged these with probability tags in the templates.

I'll join the 6/12 slot. Marcus — can you confirm capacity constraints for Q3 (esp. model shards / infra spend) so we can quantify the constrained scenario?

Vivek
Chief Operating Officer
Redwood Inference

On Wed, Jun 10, 2026 at 11:03 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com> wrote:
> Irene — thanks for pulling this together. Quick reactions:
>
> - The base-case revenue cadence looks reasonable but the optimistic scenario assumes a faster enterprise win rate — we should gate that on two GTM hires and one marketplace placement.

Adding a couple of GTM specifics:

- I updated the sheet with a channel uplift assumption tied to a marketplace listing — conservatively set at +8% ARR in year one if certification completes by Sep.
- On hiring: we should treat the first two GTM hires as conditional hires that kick in only if we clear a $X pipeline milestone; I added thresholds in the Capacity tab.
- For the QBR storyline: rather than three standalone narratives, propose we map each scenario to a single, simple signal (Lead quality, Marketplace, Cost efficiency) so the board can see the trigger for each delta. I added a short note in QBR_storyline_draft.md.

Also attaching an updated capacity model (small file) with revised ramp-to-productivity numbers.

Jonas Weber
SVP, GTM
Redwood Inference

Thanks — reviewed the templates and capacity model. A few practical notes:

- Headcount ramp: I pushed a more conservative productivity curve into capacity_model_v2.csv (attached). If hiring happens in Aug/Sep, productivity won't hit steady-state until Q1 FY29; I annotated the monthly EOY numbers.
- Infra: constrained scenario assumes a 22% increase in GPU spot costs vs. on-demand; I added a sensitivity row. That drives the ~$900K delta you see in the constrained column.
- Calendar: I scheduled the 6/12 10:00 AM PT review and added the drive link and a short prep checklist in the calendar invite (link below). Please add comments to the sheet before the meeting so we can go into decision mode.
